title: Asahina Mafuyu — Leisurely Preparations〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Exhibit Hall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to see how Ena's doing, let's start from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to go back for one of the pamphlets they had at the reception desk. I forgot to take one earlier.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good idea. Those usually list all the paintings and their titles, so I'll grab one too...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, shall we return to the entrance?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... The theme of this exhibit is “Deep in the Night”, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and most of these paintings appear to go along with that theme. But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The night from each one feels so different.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This painting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa... This one feels a lot darker than the others we've seen so far.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This alleyway turns pitch black up ahead, and it feels like the buildings on each side are closing in on the viewer. Like you're about to get crushed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sensing so much pain.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is incredible. I didn't realize a painting could invoke such deep feelings...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see a bit of Ena in this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also seeing some similarities.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena's art also has this way of bringing a lot of different feelings to the surface.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. The illustrations she does for N25 in particular since they're like a visual representation of your feelings, Kanade, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It made me realize just how much Ena's art has supported us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, we're pretty far in now.
The next painting is...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This one...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
A lot of feelings went into the other paintings we saw...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But there's more to this one.
It feels different for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's titled... “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It does feel different from the others for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... But all the technical stuff feels the same. His style hasn't changed, and the colors he used aren't wildly different or anything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What sets this one apart...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Light...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Light is more central to this painting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: He had light in his other paintings, but it looked like it was emphasizing the night and darkness...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But the light in this one feels special for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. Something else went into this painting. Something much deeper.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something deeper...? Right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have no idea what Ena's dad was feeling when he drew this painting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's clear that it means a lot to him.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: ...that's the last one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I'm glad we got to take our time and see all of them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, is that a gift shop?
I wanna get some postcards of the paintings I really liked.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to take a look too. How about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promised Miku and the others that I'd bring back some souvenirs, so I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, let's take a look!
Let's see... The postcards are all...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Over there! Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They have quite a wide selection here.
They even have some different paintings to the ones we saw today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Miku might like this painting...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's that one... “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you like that one, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had to ask since you've been staring at it for quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I can't stop looking at it for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, wanna buy these together?
I was also thinking about getting some postcards of this one!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, that sounds good...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to also get this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's take these up front♪
